primaryChecks.text: “LORD, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The mountains quaked at the LORD’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of the LORD, the God of Israel.
